msContents.summary: A palm-leaf manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.explicit: aputrasya jagachśūnyam aputrasya kṛtas sukhaṃ | putreṇa lokā jayati pu

lg.l:
kathayantaṃ hi tīrtthānāṃ prabhāvānat_bhu
tāṃs tathā |
romaśan dharmatatvajñaṃ paryyapracśad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
yo rakṣet_ prāṇinaṃ rājā bhavārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tat tan me brūhi pi tapodhana |
ekataḥ kratavas sarvve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇināṃ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ |
atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |

indrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śīi
ber auśīnarasya ca |
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārtthaṃ śibin nṛpaṃ |
indra śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bbhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ |

athorun nṛpateḥ prāpya kapota śyenajāt_
bhayāt |
śaraṇārtthan mahīpāla nililye bhayavihvalaḥ |
tataś śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vataḥ |

dharmātmā
nam ihāhus tvām ekaṃ sarvve mahīkṣitaḥ | bhuvi prāhur ekaṃ tvādyamahīkṣitam |
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathan dharmmañ cikīrṣati | si |
bhavān_ kṛtaghnan dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ |

kṣamayā krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā
jayet |
nopakāraparo py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare pi tvam upakararo yathā |
ahite tvaṃ hitaḥ pāpe tvam āpo pi sarvvadā |

doṣānveṣaṇada
kṣāṇāṃ guṇānveṣaṇatat_paraḥ |
sadaiva vihito bhāvaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣadhā |
māhākṣīr ddharmmalopena dharmmam ut_sṛja mā naśī |

santrastarūpī trāṇārtthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃ
gamaḥ |
mat_sakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnurayaṃ khagaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasyāhayārtthinaḥ |
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryyān tyāgaṃ sat_bhir vvigarhitaṃ |

lobhād veṣāt_ bhayād vāpi
yas tyajet_c śaraṇāgataṃ |
brahmahatyāsaman tasya pāpam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir ddṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahantus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit |

yathātma
naḥ priyāḥ prāṇāṃ sarvveṣāṃ prāṇinān tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastāḥ trāteavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nnityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |

jantavaḥ
parikliśyanti mṛtyos trasyanti te tataḥ |
yannimittaṃ bhavec śokas trāso vā krodha eva vā |
āyāso vā yato mūlan tad evāṅgam api tyajet |

mariṣyāmīti ya
d duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |
śakyan tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣitum |
yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |

saṃrakṣya
te jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ |
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ |
yad atra yuktam anyan te karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada |

āhārāt_ sarvvabhūtā
ni saṃbhavanti janeśvara |
āhāreṇa vivarddhante tena jīvanti caiva hi |
śakyate duṣkare py artthe cirarātrāya jīvituṃ |
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kṣaṇaṃ |

tasmā
d vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇā viśāṃpate |
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyanti panthānam apunarbbhavaṃ |
mṛte ca mayi sarvvam me putradāraṃ vinaśyati |

rakṣamāṇaḥ kapo bahūn_ prāṇān_
yiṣyati | si |
dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharmmo na sa dharmmaḥ parantapa |
avirodhī ca yo dharmmas sa dharmmas sat_bhir ucyate |
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya vicintya gurulāghavaṃ |

yato bhūyāṃs ta
to rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇṇayaṃ |
nāto bhūyastaro dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ bhayataptānām abhayaṃ yat_ pradīyate |

varam etasya satvasya pradattañ jī
vitābhayaṃ |
na ca viprasahasrebhyo gosahasran dine dine |
abhayaṃ sarvvabūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |

datta
m iṣṭan tapas taptan tīrtthaṃ vedā śrutan tathā |
sarvvāṇy abhayadānasya kalān nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ |
catus sāgaraparyyantāṃ yo dadāti vasundharāṃ |

abhayas sa bhūte
bhyo tayor abhayado dhikaḥ |
api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ |
na ca tvat_bhayasantrastan tyakṣye dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ |

yan mamāstu śubhaṃ kiñcit te
na janmani janmani |
bhave trātā bhayārttānām ārttināśāya dehināṃ |
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyan na svargan nāpunarbhavaṃ |
prāṇinān duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaḥ |

yathā
ca nānṛtā vām etām udāhare |
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu janārddanaḥ |
āhārārtthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama |

tad yatheṣṭan tavāhāram anyam eva da
dāmy ahaṃ |
ṣa vihito smākan dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam mayotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam apy aparair mmama |
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |

mā
rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīstaṃbham āruha |
nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |
śāstrair evaṃ pradiṣṭo yan dharmmas satyadayāparaḥ |

sarvvasatveṣu yad dānaṃ
m ekā satve ca yā dayā |
sarvvasatvapradānāt tu dayaivaikā viśiṣyate |
sarvve vedā na tat_ kuryyus sarvve yajñāś ca khecara |

sarvvatīrtthābhiṣekaś ca yaḥ kuryyā
t_ prāṇinān dayā |
vāṅ_manaḥkarmmabhir yye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
dayādarśātapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |
gacśatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrata svapato pi vā |

yan na
bhūtahitārtthāya tat_ paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ |
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |
ātmavat_parirakṣanti te yānti paramāṃ gatiṃ |

prāṇināaṃ vadhyamānan tu yaś śa
ktas samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |
sakalaṃ sumahad rājyaṃ prayacśāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmayase hy anyaṃ varjayitvā kapotakaṃ |
yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā bhaktir īdṛśī |
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacśa me |
anugraham imam manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase |

etat te haṃ prayacśāmi
mama māṃsaṃ yad icśasi |
yan mat_priyaṃ hyat_ svajanaś cirād vadati vā na va |
mama tu priyam evaitat tasmān tena hitaś cirāt |
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaāśinā |

dhrūvaṃ yo
nārjaye dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ |
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yan nopayujyate |
tataḥ kim upacāro vipratyahaṃ kriyate mayā |

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce
tava māṃsañ janeśvara |
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayacśa tulayā dhruvaṃ |
tathaivāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase |
yenāsya rakṣaṇam me syād yad va tad vā vihaṃgama |
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārythivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭās tulayā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ prabhuḥ |
tyaktvātmasukhabhogecśā sarvvatas tu hitaiṣiṇiaḥ |

bhavanti
paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ |
dhriyamāṇas tulayā kapoto hy atiricyate |
punaś cot_kṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt_ sa pārtthivaḥ |

na vi
dyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃsāo sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ |
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |

nāpekṣante mahātmānas svaduḥkhā
ni mahānty api |
tadā tasmin_ sahārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe |
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha |
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmme rājña sthitiṃ parāṃ |

śa
ktasvaṃ rūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata |
indro ham asmi bhadran te kapoto havyavārgasvayaṃ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau |

naitat_ pūrvve nṛpā
ś cakrur nna kariṣyanti cāpare |
mahākāruṇikeneha yat_ kṛtan duṣkṛtaṃ yathā |
parārtthe tyajataḥ prāṇānyā prītir abhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ |
parārtthaikāntakalyāṇī svāśrayātyantaniṣṭhurā |
tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājaṃ kurute karuṇāspadaṃ |
svakarmmapāśais sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛt_snam idan jagat |

tvañ jagadduḥkhamokṣā
rtthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa |
yathā caivātmasaṃtāne vāsanā pi na śoṣitā |
tathā sarvvātmanā vāpi deheṣu prahṛtan tvayā |
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamatya ca |

aṃga vā
sadṛśai sparddhān tvaṃ lokottaratāṃ gataḥ |
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇaiānyo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmāṃ nāvartate punaḥ |

prāṇair api tvayā
rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyaieṣv anyeṣu kā kathā |
paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ |

sa punar jīvitaślāghyo yaḥ
parārtthe hi jīvati |
kiṃ vātra citraṃ yat_ santaḥ parānugrahatat_parāḥ |
na hi svadehaśaityāya jāyante candanadrumāḥ |

paropakāravyāpāreaparo yaḥ puru
ṣas sadā |
sa saṃpadam avāpnoti parād api hi yat_ paraṃ |
paropakāraikadhiyā svasukhād vigataspṛhaḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi |

yat te māṃ
sāni gātrebhyo samut_kṛttāni pārthiva |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir llokān anugāmiṣyati |
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinīṃ |

sarvvān_ lokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ ga
miṣyasi |
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālaṃ |
rājā tu kratum iṣṭvāsau mumude devat tadā |
ya viidaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śibeś caritam uttamaṃ |

sa vidhūyeha pā
pāni prayāti tridaśālayaṃ |
vicintya rājan_ svaśarīram adhruvan dhruvaṃ vayas sarvvajanasya durllabhaṃ |
śarīradānāt_ parijīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau ||

body.p:
iti śrī itihasasamucca
ye śyenakapotīyan nāma caturttho dhyāyaḥ |
